import math

# July 2010
vals_2010 = [11041, 56013, 49743, 12330]
# July 2011

# July 2012
vals_2012 = [11041, 54011, 50293, 34039]

all_vals = vals_2010 + vals_2011 + vals_2012 + vals_2013

# GM = (product of all values)^(1/n)

gm = math.exp(log_sum / len(all_vals))
print('Geometric mean:', gm)
print('Rounded to 2 decimal places:', round(gm, 2))
"
